title: Case-study growth comparison

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Use size and color contrast to distinguish two quantities so a viewer can read the direction of a comparison quickly.
strategic_value: The red endpoint can make the designer’s growth claim prominent within the Verizon project narrative.
demonstration: A large red circle labeled 5.43M appears above year 4; a smaller gray circle labeled 2.37M appears over year 1 on black, with years 2 and 3 shown as thin vertical ticks.
practical_value: Distinguish visual emphasis from quantitative proof: the unlabeled unit and sparse timeline do not establish a complete revenue dataset.

content_islands.name: Endpoint circles
content_islands.spec: Place the smaller gray circle at lower left and the larger red circle at upper right, with thin numerals centered inside.

content_islands.name: Timeline
content_islands.spec: Connect each circle toward its year label with a thin line and place the two intervening year ticks between them.

reference_purposes.Expression: Red and gray circles on black use scale and contrast to create a pronounced endpoint emphasis.
reference_purposes.Application: The chart applies the identity to the portfolio’s growth narrative; the underlying financial claim is not independently verified.
